detailed_inserted_units.task: Observe producer and consumer behavior
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: OpenAPICompatibilityInfrastructureTest: operation set and source DTO fields are fixed independently.
detailed_inserted_units.title: Observe producer and consumer behavior
detailed_inserted_units.assignment: Inspect LocalPolicyIssueController and PolicyIssueRequest. Record the two operations, auth boundary, request fields, returned status codes, and independent expected field sets. Do not change application behavior.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Complete the versioned API description
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Infrastructure checks resolve required fields/statuses and reject undocumented or extra controller operations.
detailed_inserted_units.title: Complete the versioned API description
detailed_inserted_units.assignment: Edit src/main/resources/contracts/coverstory-policies-v1.json to describe the existing POST and GET routes, request/response schemas, auth, and exact status variants including POST 200/201/400/401/404/409. Preserve the independent fixture assertions.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Compare the contract with actual Spring mappings
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Actual Spring annotations and contract operation sets must be equal; mutants adding/removing a route fail.
detailed_inserted_units.title: Compare the contract with actual Spring mappings
detailed_inserted_units.assignment: Extend OpenApiCompatibilityInfrastructureTest to compare documented verb/path pairs against LocalPolicyIssueController annotations; include method, missing-route, and extra-route counterfactuals.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Evaluate consumer compatibility for provider changes
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Independent expected diagnostics verify exact changed operations and preserve optional additions as compatible.
detailed_inserted_units.title: Evaluate consumer compatibility for provider changes
detailed_inserted_units.assignment: Implement the compatibility learner seam for additive optional response fields versus removed consumed fields, new required request fields, changed response status, and changed field types.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Run compatibility mutation controls and capture evidence
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Exact expected operation/field/status diagnostics reject compatibility mutants; declared cookie-session and CSRF requirements are checked beside actual unauthorized/CSRF-denied Spring requests and the fixed 401 body.
detailed_inserted_units.title: Run compatibility mutation controls and capture evidence
detailed_inserted_units.assignment: Run the compatibility witness against unchanged, additive, and breaking documents; introduce a deliberate always-compatible mutant and confirm the independent actual-path assertion rejects it. The local unauthenticated Spring fallback now serializes the declared ApiError as HTTP 401 JSON {"code":"UNAUTHENTICATED"}, replacing the prior framework-generated sendError body; treat this as a compatibility-visible local contract change, not evidence of external consumer migration.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Define isolated browser-login and resource-server paths
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Infrastructure test proves issuer/JWKS URLs are loopback-only and the profile is separate from application sessions.
detailed_inserted_units.title: Define isolated browser-login and resource-server paths
detailed_inserted_units.assignment: Review the isolated oidc-contract-lab profile and loopback-only synthetic issuer. Trace its authorization-code and token exchange through Spring OAuth2 Login, then the separate bearer resource-server path; preserve the existing cookie-session configuration and never configure an external issuer.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Route bearer authentication through Spring Security
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Actual MockMvc bearer path proves valid signed tokens reach authorization and invalid tokens fail before the handler.
detailed_inserted_units.title: Route bearer authentication through Spring Security
detailed_inserted_units.assignment: Trace the real SecurityFilterChain, issuer/time validator, audience validator, and default-deny route handling. Implement OidcTenantPolicy separately; do not replace token verification with a mock Authentication.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Exercise provider discovery and JWKS signature verification
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: The test observes a real signed bearer request and successful protected response; mock tokens are not accepted by this path.
detailed_inserted_units.title: Exercise provider discovery and JWKS signature verification
detailed_inserted_units.assignment: Use the disposable local issuer's discovery metadata and JWKS. Follow one signed synthetic token through discovery, key selection, signature verification, and the protected handler.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Reject issuer, audience, time, and malformed-token failures
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Each counterfactual is independently expected to fail authentication and expose no synthetic subject.
detailed_inserted_units.title: Reject issuer, audience, time, and malformed-token failures
detailed_inserted_units.assignment: Use independently signed wrong-issuer, wrong-audience, expired, and malformed tokens. Assert HTTP 401, no private body, and no successful handler response.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Reject unknown key identifiers and invalid token structure
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Unknown kid, unsigned, bad-signature, and malformed-token controls fail on the actual decoder path with HTTP 401 and no claim disclosure.
detailed_inserted_units.title: Reject unknown key identifiers and invalid token structure
detailed_inserted_units.assignment: Exercise malformed compact, unsigned, bad-signature, and validly signed unknown-kid tokens through the actual resource-server filter chain. Confirm each returns HTTP 401 without claim disclosure.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Test key rotation and overlap
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Positive controls for both published keys and a negative unknown-key control exercise JWKS retrieval.
detailed_inserted_units.title: Test key rotation and overlap
detailed_inserted_units.assignment: Use only the local synthetic issuer. Verify the previously active and newly published key IDs during overlap, then an unknown-key denial; record that this lab does not establish immediate revocation behavior.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Enforce tenant ownership in the authorization path
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Same-tenant positive control and malformed/foreign-tenant negative controls use fixed claims.
detailed_inserted_units.title: Enforce tenant ownership in the authorization path
detailed_inserted_units.assignment: Implement the learner OidcTenantPolicy using exact tenant claim equality. Reject foreign, absent, blank, and wrongly typed claims; the instructor witness remains separate from learner implementation.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Apply least-privilege scope checks
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: The acceptance matrix tests scope tokenization and tenant relation independently.
detailed_inserted_units.title: Apply least-privilege scope checks
detailed_inserted_units.assignment: Require the exact policy.read permission for this GET route. Verify policy.write, unknown scopes, substrings, blank scopes, and tenant mismatch do not authorize.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Run full protocol and authorization acceptance
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Protocol infrastructure and learner authorization acceptance are separately reported.
detailed_inserted_units.title: Run full protocol and authorization acceptance
detailed_inserted_units.assignment: Run the complete isolated protocol suite and learner policy acceptance. Preserve the actual issuer/JWKS test path and record any failure as a blocker, not completion.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Pin the baseline rows and compatibility boundary
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Fixed expected rows and schema columns are asserted before any candidate migration.
detailed_inserted_units.title: Pin the baseline rows and compatibility boundary
detailed_inserted_units.assignment: Use disposable embedded PostgreSQL and migration V001 in the isolated schema-evolution lab. Record exact fixture IDs/values and create an independent expected row map for old and new readers.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Apply an additive expand migration
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Independent row snapshot is byte-stable across expansion and an old-shape insert remains valid.
detailed_inserted_units.title: Apply an additive expand migration
detailed_inserted_units.assignment: Apply the lab's versioned nullable column migration. Verify the preexisting rows remain exact, old insert/read SQL still works, and the new column accepts a value.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Backfill bounded batches with a durable cursor
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Acceptance compares exact IDs, values, cursor and total row count after each bounded batch.
detailed_inserted_units.title: Backfill bounded batches with a durable cursor
detailed_inserted_units.assignment: Implement the resumable backfill learner seam over stable integer IDs using bounded ordered batches and a stored cursor. The expected target values and IDs are fixed independently.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Interrupt and resume without skips or duplicates
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: The learner-path database-trigger failure proves atomic rollback before resume; exact IDs, full values, version/update counts, cursor and wrong-row mutant are checked. Independent SQL fixture tests remain separate.
detailed_inserted_units.title: Interrupt and resume without skips or duplicates
detailed_inserted_units.assignment: Use fresh bounded-runner invocations against only the persisted database cursor; this is not a claimed JVM-crash reproduction. Inject a database-trigger failure after the first row update in the learner implementation, verify all rows and cursor roll back on fresh connections, then rerun the learner and compare every ordered row/cursor exactly.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Check old/new reader and writer compatibility
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Actual SQL queries for both schema generations match independent expected rows.
detailed_inserted_units.title: Check old/new reader and writer compatibility
detailed_inserted_units.assignment: Execute fixed old-shape read/write SQL before and after backfill, and new-shape reads after it. Verify exact row sets and that the additive field does not break old code paths.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Reject destructive change and demonstrate forward recovery
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: A dropped-column mutant is rejected; forward migration restores the expected schema/values without claiming rollback semantics.
detailed_inserted_units.title: Reject destructive change and demonstrate forward recovery
detailed_inserted_units.assignment: Prove a destructive candidate migration fails the schema/row acceptance boundary. Recover only by applying a forward migration in a fresh disposable DB and compare exact rows.

detailed_inserted_units.task: Verify cleanup eligibility and publish migration evidence
detailed_inserted_units.acceptance: Learner backfill/gate acceptance plus independent PostgreSQL fixture verify complete exact rows, both reader/writer retirements, migration history, and denied premature contract.
detailed_inserted_units.title: Verify cleanup eligibility and publish migration evidence
detailed_inserted_units.assignment: In a new disposable database, run the learner bounded backfill, prove exact values/cursor/update counts, and contract only when every old reader and writer is retired and backfill completion is verified. Capture exact migration history and row digest.
